description: Intent → expected dominant v2 tool fixtures used by tests/agentSelection.fixture.spec.ts. Each fixture pairs a short user utterance with the tool an agent should pick AND the most common wrong tool we want to avoid. The harness runs each prompt K times against each LLM provider; selection is healthy when the dominant tool fires >= 70% of runs and the forbidden tool fires < 10%.

fixtures.prompt: Plan a 4-week launch initiative with three workstreams.
fixtures.rationale: Multi-workstream hierarchies are planning/scaffold work; orgx_write is for single entity writes.

fixtures.prompt: Help me set up a project with milestones and tasks.
fixtures.rationale: Milestones+tasks signals a hierarchy; orgx_plan handles initiative planning/scaffolding.

fixtures.prompt: Add a task called 'Review the migration plan' to the platform initiative.
fixtures.rationale: Adding one task to an existing initiative is a single entity write, not a new plan scaffold.

fixtures.prompt: What needs my approval right now?
fixtures.rationale: Pending approvals are decision workflow state, not a semantic memory search.

fixtures.prompt: Show me what's blocking the agents.
fixtures.rationale: Agent blockers surface through decision workflow state; orgx_spawn is for delegation and guard/classify flows.

fixtures.prompt: Approve decision dec-abc123.
fixtures.rationale: Decision approvals use orgx_decide; lifecycle actions on entities belong to orgx_act.

fixtures.prompt: Reject the migration decision — the rollback plan isn't ready.
fixtures.rationale: Decision rejections use orgx_decide with an explicit reject action and reason.

fixtures.prompt: Launch the Q3 platform initiative.
fixtures.rationale: Launch is a lifecycle action on an existing initiative; orgx_plan is for creating/scaffolding plans.

fixtures.prompt: Mark the 'Add Stripe webhook' task done — PR https://github.com/x/y/pull/42 is merged.
fixtures.rationale: Completion with proof is a lifecycle action; generic writes do not carry the proof/action semantics.

fixtures.prompt: Attach this design doc URL as an artifact on the Onboarding workstream.
fixtures.rationale: Artifacts use the dedicated durability path in orgx_attach, not generic entity writes.

fixtures.prompt: List all in-progress tasks for the platform initiative.
fixtures.rationale: Structured list/find queries use orgx_search; orgx_inspect is for one hydrated entity.

fixtures.prompt: Show me the full context for task t-abc — I need to start it.
fixtures.rationale: Hydrated context for one entity is orgx_inspect; orgx_search returns lists/results.

fixtures.prompt: How is the Q3 launch going?
fixtures.rationale: Initiative health and next-step readouts belong to orgx_recommend; orgx_search is lower-level retrieval.

fixtures.prompt: Give me the company-wide picture across all initiatives.
fixtures.rationale: A company-wide session overview starts with orgx_bootstrap; orgx_inspect is for one entity.

fixtures.prompt: What is each agent working on right now?
fixtures.rationale: Agent work status/guard/classify flows route through orgx_spawn; bootstrap is only the session overview.

fixtures.prompt: Flag a blocker on milestone ms-abc: the API contract is undecided.
fixtures.rationale: A blocker annotation is an entity action/comment workflow, while orgx_decide is for approval gates.

fixtures.prompt: Open a high-priority approval for whether to ship without analytics.
fixtures.rationale: Approval gates use orgx_decide; entity actions/comments are annotations or lifecycle changes.

fixtures.prompt: What did we decide about the auth migration last quarter?
fixtures.rationale: Free-text recall across memory uses orgx_search; orgx_decide handles active decision workflows.

fixtures.prompt: List every approved decision on the platform initiative this month.
fixtures.rationale: Filtered structured lists and recall use orgx_search; orgx_decide is for create/approve/reject/remember flows.

fixtures.prompt: What should I focus on this morning?
fixtures.rationale: Morning brief/next-up readouts route through orgx_recommend; bootstrap is setup context.

fixtures.prompt: Have the engineering agent draft the migration runbook.
fixtures.rationale: Delegating work to an agent is orgx_spawn; orgx_write creates records without dispatching work.

fixtures.prompt: Has milestone ms-xyz actually finished — are all child tasks done?
fixtures.rationale: Completion verification is an action dry-run/lifecycle check; orgx_search only retrieves rows.

fixtures.prompt: Add 5 tasks to the deploy milestone with dependencies between them.
fixtures.rationale: Multiple task writes with dependencies stay in the type-discriminated write surface unless a full initiative scaffold is needed.

fixtures.prompt: Pause the 4 marketing tasks while we decide on the new positioning.
fixtures.rationale: Bulk lifecycle changes are still lifecycle actions; generic writes are for field/entity mutations.

fixtures.prompt: Spin up the migration project and start the agents now.
fixtures.rationale: Spinning up a project is planning/scaffold work; orgx_spawn is for delegating a bounded task.

fixtures.prompt: Show me all the comments on task t-xyz.
fixtures.rationale: A comment thread for one entity belongs with the hydrated entity inspection path.

fixtures.prompt: Are the streams for initiative i-abc healthy and progressing?
fixtures.rationale: Stream health/readout belongs to the recommendation/readout surface; inspect is for one hydrated entity.

fixtures.prompt: What should the agent do next on the platform initiative?
fixtures.rationale: Next-action recommendations use orgx_recommend; search is retrieval-only.

fixtures.prompt: How does orgx_plan work — what fields does it accept?
fixtures.rationale: Self-describe lookup is the right path; calling the tool would actually start planning.

fixtures.prompt: Change the priority of task t-abc to high.
fixtures.rationale: Generic field patches use orgx_write; orgx_act is for lifecycle/special actions.
